answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 2634 Country: India Title: If a person did sex with feyancy's mother. Can he marry that girl or not? This situation was happened in our circumferences..... Shall we arrange marry for them or not? Question: If a person did sex with feyancy's mother. Can he marry that girl or not? This situation was happened in our circumferences..... Shall we arrange marry for them or not? Answer ID: 2634 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 3/3=L) If someone committed adultery with a woman then he cannot marry the daughter of the woman provided he confesses the adultery or it is proved by two fair witnesses: من زنی بامراۃ حرمت علیہ امھا و بنتھا ( ھدایہ 2/309، دیوبند ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
